title: Colonel Roosevelt is invited to fly in Arch Hoxsey's plane at St. Louis, Mo., 1910
maker: unknown newsreel camera; Theodore Roosevelt Association Collection (former owner Roosevelt Memorial Association)
loc_summary: Theodore Roosevelt ... is invited to fly in a biplane piloted by Arch Hoxsey. ... he arrives by motorcade, inspects the plane, boards it, and flies.
film_intertitles: In 1910, the Wright Brothers arranged an air meet in St. Louis.
When Archie Hoxsey asks the Colonel to take a flight, Roosevelt answers, 'No, thank you. There are enough high-fliers up there already.'
But the Colonel changes his mind.
